about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know the person behind the code
about.location: Based in Scarborough, ON • Multidisciplinary background
about.storyText1: I bridge the gap between human behavior and complex computing. With a background that uniquely blends a degree in Psychology with an Advanced Diploma in Computer Programming, I look at software through a dual lens: deep logical problem-solving and intuitive, user-centric design.
about.storyText2: Currently expanding my technical foundations in Software Engineering at McMaster University, my focus has evolved from building responsive web applications to engineering scalable, high-performance software and robust systems architecture. From optimizing custom backend engines to developing open-source data structure libraries, I thrive on writing clean, mathematically sound, and highly efficient code.
about.storyText3: When I'm not designing systems, you'll usually find me pushing limits at the gym, diving into complex math puzzles, or sharpening my algorithmic skills on LeetCode. I am driven by relentless optimization—both in the IDE and in personal growth.

qaLab.title: Quality Engineering Lab
qaLab.subtitle: I treat this portfolio like a product under test. I map risks first, shape a real test pyramid, wire CI gates, and leave the exact commands I run — so you can verify the green path yourself.
qaLab.pyramidBody: I keep most of my coverage in fast unit and contract tests at the base. I add Playwright only for journeys I'd be embarrassed to break in production. I still do exploratory passes for UX calls automation can't own.
qaLab.riskBody: I don't test every button equally. I start with what would break visitor trust — then I attach an automated gate or a deliberate manual check.

risks.nav: Broken navigation / blank routes — I guard these with publicRoutes + E2E smoke
risks.projects: API pagination / contract drift — I lock shape with server contract tests
risks.camera: Showcase app crash (Camera FX) — I smoke-test heading + primary CTA in E2E
risks.locale: FR/EN string gaps — I enforce structural i18n parity in CI
risks.deploy: Stale chunks / SW drift — I catch these with build gates, smoke, and an LHCI budget

qaLab.gatesBody: I don't merge on hope. Each gate blocks a different failure mode before it ships.

improve.one: I trace requirements → risks → tests, and I skip low-value UI click soup.
improve.two: I grow unit and contract coverage first; I add E2E only for money-path journeys.
improve.three: I treat flaky tests as defects — quarantine, fix root cause, or delete.
improve.four: I publish evidence: CI logs, Playwright reports, Lighthouse scores — so results are verifiable.

qaLab.futureTitle: What I want to improve next
qaLab.futureBody: Honest backlog — what I'd tackle on the next quality sprint:

future.one: Visual regression snapshots for Camera FX and the homepage hero (Playwright screenshot diff).
future.two: Contract tests against a seeded Mongo fixture, not just the in-memory engine.
future.three: Accessibility audits beyond skip-link smoke — axe-core in CI on critical routes.
future.four: E2E against a live API in preview (start Express alongside vite preview in CI).
future.five: Mutation testing on pagination helpers and lazyWithRetry recovery logic.
